description: This file serves as an index module exporting various functions, types, and constants related to Excalidraw elements, including hashing, filtering, and utility functions, as well as re-exporting multiple submodules.

methods.name: getSceneVersion
methods.description: Deprecated function to compute a scene version by summing element versions.

methods.name: hashElementsVersion
methods.description: Hashes elements' versionNonce using djb2 algorithm, order-sensitive.

methods.name: hashString
methods.description: Computes a hash of a string using djb2 algorithm, not cryptographically secure.

methods.name: getVisibleElements
methods.description: Filters and returns elements that are not deleted and not invisibly small.

methods.name: getNonDeletedElements
methods.description: Filters and returns elements that are not marked as deleted.

methods.name: isNonDeletedElement
methods.description: Type guard to check if an element is not deleted.
